summary_en: BCJ-110 completed a public tender offer for eSOL shares from September 2 through October 19, 2026, acquiring 12,759,681 shares. Settlement on October 26, 2026 will result in BCJ-110 becoming the parent company and largest shareholder with majority voting rights, with BCJ-109 as ultimate parent.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Public Tender Offer for Shares of eSOL Co., Ltd. by BCJ-110 Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company and Principal Shareholder
translation_en_brief:
BCJ-110 Co., Ltd. completed its public tender offer for eSOL Co., Ltd. shares on October 19, 2026, following an offer period that began on September 2, 2026. The tender offer resulted in 12,759,681 shares being tendered, which exceeded the minimum acceptance threshold of 10,535,800 shares, causing the offer to succeed. BCJ-110 will acquire all tendered shares.

Settlement of the tender offer is scheduled to begin on October 26, 2026. Upon completion of settlement, BCJ-110 will own more than 50 percent of eSOL's voting rights and will become the company's parent company and principal shareholder. BCJ-110 itself is wholly owned by BCJ-109, which will thereby become eSOL's parent company through indirect ownership. As a result of the settlement, the eSOL Employee Stock Ownership Plan, which was previously the principal shareholder, will cease to hold that status.
